report.rootCause: The getCurrentPeriod() method throws RuntimeException when no open inventory period exists for the restaurant, and there's no exception handler to convert this to a proper 404 HTTP response
report.currentBehavior: When no open period exists, periodRepository.findFirstByRestaurantIdAndInventoryTypeAndStatus() returns empty Optional, which triggers orElseThrow() to throw RuntimeException('No open period found'), resulting in 500 Internal Server Error
report.expectedBehavior: Return a proper 404 Not Found response with a meaningful message, or auto-create a new period if business logic requires one to always exist
evidence: PhysicalInventoryService.java:47-51: orElseThrow(() -> new RuntimeException("No open period found")) - throws unhandled exception when Optional is empty
InventoryController.java:109-114: getCurrentPeriod() calls the service method without try-catch
No @ControllerAdvice or @ExceptionHandler exists in the codebase to handle RuntimeException
report.recommendedFix: Change PhysicalInventoryService.getCurrentPeriod() to return Optional<PhysicalInventoryPeriodDto> and handle empty case in controller with ResponseEntity.notFound().build(), OR add a global exception handler that maps RuntimeException to 404 status
